title: Teddy And Peddy Went Into Jungle

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {yay} Teddy! Pack your bag. We are going to the *jungle*!

segments.say: Teddy! Pack your bag. We are going to the *jungle*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {haan} The jungle? With lions and snakes? No, thank you.

segments.say: The jungle? With lions and snakes? No, thank you.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {hmm} There is a hidden *treasure* there. A golden *banana*!

segments.say: There is a hidden *treasure* there. A golden *banana*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {wow} A golden banana? {love} Why didn't you say that first?

segments.say: A golden banana?
Why didn't you say that first?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Because you always eat everything first! {facepalm}

segments.say: Because you always eat everything first!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {giggle} True. Okay, I am bringing ten *samosas*. For energy.

segments.say: True. Okay, I am bringing ten *samosas*. For energy.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {uff} Ten? We need a *map*, not a buffet!

segments.say: Ten? We need a *map*, not a buffet!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {ohoo} Relax. My stomach is my map. {laugh}

segments.say: Relax. My stomach is my map.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {look-around} Okay, the jungle bus leaves in two minutes!

segments.say: Okay, the jungle bus leaves in two minutes!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {phone} Wait, let me take a *selfie* first.

segments.say: Wait, let me take a *selfie* first.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {haan} Teddy! The {show:bus} *bus* is leaving!

segments.say: Teddy! The
*bus* is leaving!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {aah} Wait for us, Mister Bus! {jump}

segments.say: Wait for us, Mister Bus!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {uff} We missed it. Because of your *selfie*.

segments.say: We missed it. Because of your *selfie*.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {idea} No problem. We will walk! It is only… *fifty* kilometers.

segments.say: No problem. We will walk! It is only… *fifty* kilometers.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {dizzy} Fifty?! My legs are crying already.

segments.say: Fifty?! My legs are crying already.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {giggle} Then let your legs cry while we walk! {walk-out}

segments.say: Then let your legs cry while we walk!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {aah} Finally! The *jungle*! Smell that fresh air! {sniff}

segments.say: Finally! The *jungle*! Smell that fresh air!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {sniff} Hmm… I smell *samosas*. Oh wait, that's my bag.

segments.say: Hmm… I smell *samosas*. Oh wait, that's my bag.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {look-around} Shhh. Did you hear that? Something is in the *trees*.

segments.say: Shhh. Did you hear that? Something is in the *trees*.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {scared} Is it a lion? Please say it's not a lion!

segments.say: Is it a lion? Please say it's not a lion!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {gasp} It's a {show:monkey} *monkey*!

segments.say: It's a
*monkey*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {wow} Aww, he is so cute! {love} Hello, little buddy!

segments.say: Aww, he is so cute!
Hello, little buddy!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {haan} Teddy… he took your *bag*!

segments.say: Teddy… he took your *bag*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: MY SAMOSAS! {angry} Come back, you thief!

segments.say: MY SAMOSAS!
Come back, you thief!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {cry} He ate all ten. All ten *samosas*.

segments.say: He ate all ten. All ten *samosas*.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {facepalm} I told you to bring a *map*, not snacks.

segments.say: I told you to bring a *map*, not snacks.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {hmm} Okay, okay. Where is the map, genius?

segments.say: Okay, okay. Where is the map, genius?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {look-around} It was… in your bag.

segments.say: It was… in your bag.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {ohoo} So the monkey has our *map* too!

segments.say: So the monkey has our *map* too!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {oops} Now the monkey will find the golden banana. {sweat}

segments.say: Now the monkey will find the golden banana.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {think} Wait. A monkey… with a map… finding a banana? {laugh} That's perfect for him!

segments.say: Wait. A monkey… with a map… finding a banana?
That's perfect for him!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {uff} Not funny! Come on, follow those *footprints*.

segments.say: Not funny! Come on, follow those *footprints*.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {look-around} The footprints stop here. Next to this *river*.

segments.say: The footprints stop here. Next to this *river*.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {hmm} Peddy… why is that log *smiling* at us?

segments.say: Peddy… why is that log *smiling* at us?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {gasp} That's not a log! That's a {show:crocodile} *crocodile*!

segments.say: That's not a log! That's a
*crocodile*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {aah} RUN, PEDDY, RUN! {jump}

segments.say: RUN, PEDDY, RUN!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {scared} I can't run! My shoe is *stuck*!

segments.say: I can't run! My shoe is *stuck*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {idea} Throw him your *shoe*! Crocodiles love shoes!

segments.say: Throw him your *shoe*! Crocodiles love shoes!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {haan} Who told you that?!

segments.say: Who told you that?!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {giggle} Nobody. But look, it worked! He is eating it!

segments.say: Nobody. But look, it worked! He is eating it!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {uff} Great. Now I have *one* shoe in a jungle.

segments.say: Great. Now I have *one* shoe in a jungle.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {dizzy} I'm so hungry. I can see *pizza* everywhere.

segments.say: I'm so hungry. I can see *pizza* everywhere.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {facepalm} Teddy, that's a *rock*. Please don't lick it.

segments.say: Teddy, that's a *rock*. Please don't lick it.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {sniff} It smells like cheese… a little bit.

segments.say: It smells like cheese… a little bit.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {look-around} Wait. Look up! {show:parrot} A *parrot*!

segments.say: Wait. Look up!
A *parrot*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {wow} Hello, Mister Parrot! Do you know where the golden banana is?

segments.say: Hello, Mister Parrot! Do you know where the golden banana is?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {hmm} Teddy, parrots can't give directions.

segments.say: Teddy, parrots can't give directions.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {gasp} He is flying that way! He is helping us!

segments.say: He is flying that way! He is helping us!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {ohoo} Or he is just going home. {shrug} Fine, let's follow him.

segments.say: Or he is just going home.
Fine, let's follow him.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {sweat} It's getting dark. We need a place to *sleep*.

segments.say: It's getting dark. We need a place to *sleep*.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {yay} Camping! I love camping! I'll make a *fire*!

segments.say: Camping! I love camping! I'll make a *fire*!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {hmm} Do you know how to make a fire?

segments.say: Do you know how to make a fire?

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {phone} Yes. I watched one *video*. Thirty seconds.

segments.say: Yes. I watched one *video*. Thirty seconds.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {facepalm} That's not experience, that's a *reel*!

segments.say: That's not experience, that's a *reel*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {clap} Look! Smoke! Smoke! I did it!

segments.say: Look! Smoke! Smoke! I did it!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {gasp} Teddy, that smoke is coming from your *socks*!

segments.say: Teddy, that smoke is coming from your *socks*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {aah} HOT HOT HOT! {jump} {dance}

segments.say: HOT HOT HOT!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {scared} Peddy… are you awake?

segments.say: Peddy… are you awake?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {wake} Now I am. What is it?

segments.say: Now I am. What is it?

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {look-around} Something big is breathing behind me.

segments.say: Something big is breathing behind me.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {hmm} It's just the *wind*. Go to sleep.

segments.say: It's just the *wind*. Go to sleep.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {gasp} The wind has *teeth*?!

segments.say: The wind has *teeth*?!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {aah} It's a {show:tiger} *TIGER*!

segments.say: It's a
*TIGER*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {idea} Stay calm! Tigers hate *singing*!

segments.say: Stay calm! Tigers hate *singing*!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {haan} Then SING, Teddy! SING!

segments.say: Then SING, Teddy! SING!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {dance} La la laaa… I am a happy *teddy*…

segments.say: La la laaa… I am a happy *teddy*…

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {wow} He is running away! Your singing is a *weapon*!

segments.say: He is running away! Your singing is a *weapon*!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {wake} Good morning, jungle! {yay} We survived the night!

segments.say: Good morning, jungle!
We survived the night!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {uff} Barely. My voice is gone after all that *singing*.

segments.say: Barely. My voice is gone after all that *singing*.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {look-around} Look! The {show:parrot} parrot is back! And he is pointing!

segments.say: Look! The
parrot is back! And he is pointing!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {gasp} He is pointing at that big *cave*!

segments.say: He is pointing at that big *cave*!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {hmm} A dark cave in the jungle. What could go wrong?

segments.say: A dark cave in the jungle. What could go wrong?

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {giggle} Everything. But… golden banana!

segments.say: Everything. But… golden banana!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {nod} For the golden banana! {walk-out}

segments.say: For the golden banana!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {scared} It's so dark in here. I can't see my own *nose*.

segments.say: It's so dark in here. I can't see my own *nose*.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {phone} Use your phone *light*.

segments.say: Use your phone *light*.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {oops} Battery is two percent. Because of the *selfies*.

segments.say: Battery is two percent. Because of the *selfies*.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {facepalm} Of course it is. {uff}

segments.say: Of course it is.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {gasp} Peddy… I see something shining!

segments.say: Peddy… I see something shining!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {wow} It's gold! It's the GOLDEN BANANA!

segments.say: It's gold! It's the GOLDEN BANANA!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {yay} We are *rich*! We are so rich! {dance}

segments.say: We are *rich*! We are so rich!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {haan} Wait. Who is holding it?

segments.say: Wait. Who is holding it?

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {gasp} It's the {show:monkey} *monkey*! The samosa thief!

segments.say: It's the
*monkey*! The samosa thief!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {angry} Give us that banana, you little *thief*!

segments.say: Give us that banana, you little *thief*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {hmm} Wait… he is holding our *map* too.

segments.say: Wait… he is holding our *map* too.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {look-around} And… he drew a *heart* on it. {love}

segments.say: And… he drew a *heart* on it.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {ohoo} He found the treasure for us! He is our *friend*!

segments.say: He found the treasure for us! He is our *friend*!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {cry} Aww. I feel bad for calling him a thief.

segments.say: Aww. I feel bad for calling him a thief.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {nod} Me too. Can I have my *samosas* back, buddy?

segments.say: Me too. Can I have my *samosas* back, buddy?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {laugh} Teddy, he ate them yesterday!

segments.say: Teddy, he ate them yesterday!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {look-around} Okay, now we just need to go *home*.

segments.say: Okay, now we just need to go *home*.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {gasp} With what? We don't have a map, a bus, or *shoes*!

segments.say: With what? We don't have a map, a bus, or *shoes*!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {hmm} Hey, I still have *one* shoe.

segments.say: Hey, I still have *one* shoe.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {giggle} Great. Half of you can go home.

segments.say: Great. Half of you can go home.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {idea} Wait! The {show:elephant} *elephant*! Maybe he can give us a ride!

segments.say: Wait! The
*elephant*! Maybe he can give us a ride!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {wow} An elephant taxi! Best day ever!

segments.say: An elephant taxi! Best day ever!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {jump} Hold on tight, Teddy!

segments.say: Hold on tight, Teddy!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {aah} I'm too high! I'm too *HIGH*!

segments.say: I'm too high! I'm too *HIGH*!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {yay} Home sweet home! And we have the *golden banana*!

segments.say: Home sweet home! And we have the *golden banana*!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {hmm} Peddy… why is it getting *soft*?

segments.say: Peddy… why is it getting *soft*?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {haan} Soft? Gold doesn't get soft!

segments.say: Soft? Gold doesn't get soft!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {sniff} It smells like… a real *banana*. Painted gold.

segments.say: It smells like… a real *banana*. Painted gold.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {shock} We walked fifty kilometers… for a painted *banana*?!

segments.say: We walked fifty kilometers… for a painted *banana*?!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {eat} Well… it's a very tasty *treasure*. {giggle}

segments.say: Well… it's a very tasty *treasure*.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {facepalm} Next time, I'm going alone.

segments.say: Next time, I'm going alone.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {ohoo} Next time… let's go to the *desert*! {laugh}

segments.say: Next time… let's go to the *desert*!
